title: PDE and Domain Bridge

closed kernel relation encoding div(q) = g
graph-relation membership implies the actual distributional InHDiv predicate

ranked_next_proofs.goal: Prove the complex smooth H(div) graph core lies in the closed distributional graph relation and pass the result to its topological closure.
Construct the explicit real-v3.28-to-complex distributional graph map and prove derivative/divergence compatibility.
Build a bounded-box graph closure whose continuous trace agrees with classical signed face flux on a common dense smooth core.

nonclaims: The existing whole-space graphNormalTrace is not yet identified directly with a bounded-box classical face-flux trace.
The real v3.28 graph closure is not yet proved equivalent to the complex distributional H(div) graph relation.
No reverse inclusion from arbitrary distributional H(div) data to the smooth graph closure is claimed without a graph-norm density/mollification theorem.
No zero-extension theorem is assumed to commute with divergence across a box boundary.
